ai_summary: Smiti Holding and Trading Company Private Limited, a promoter of Asian Paints Limited, has pledged an additional 26.79 lakh shares (0.28% of total share capital) of Asian Paints between September 16-17, 2026, to secure various loans. This action increases the promoter's total encumbered shareholding in Asian Paints to 3.867 crore shares, representing 4.03% of the company's total share capital. The rising proportion of pledged promoter shares is a potential red flag, suggesting liquidity pressures within the promoter group which could impact investor confidence.
